This my sorghum plot is small, only 0.24 hectare, and I have intercropped it with cowpea like we always do here in the North. The rains will come soon, maybe June, so I must prepare. I will buy a small bag of NPK if I can get it from the agro-dealer, and add the manure from my goats and chickens — that one costs me nothing. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year, so I will plant the sorghum seed I kept from last harvest, and my children and I will do most of the weeding ourselves.
